text:
Maya: Heads up — CI perf on main just tripped again. p95 for small-batch tests jumped from ~32ms -> ~120ms.
Eric: Seen it. Logs show a huge wave of compile tasks starting at ~14:12 UTC. Could be autotune flip. :thinking_face: 
build-bot: CI alert: perf/regression/small-batch exceeded threshold. Run: ci-run/2026-03-18-1420
Noah: I kicked off a bisect. Preliminary points to merge PR #2487 — commit abcdef012345 — it changed the kernel scoring function (prefers kernel_C for seq <= 64).
Lina: Right, #2487 nudged scores to favor kernel_C when mem_pressure < 0.2. kernel_C is fast for long runs but goes through the JIT/compile path for some micro-batches, which can blow up compile churn.
Eric: Can you paste the runtime profiler spans / compile logs here? I'm seeing compile_count spike by orders of magnitude.
Noah: ```
[14:11:58] compile_task_enqueue: model=redwood-v3 kernel=kernel_C seq=48
[14:11:58] compile_worker_spawn: id=42 workers=16 queue=482
[14:11:59] compile_start: file=/tmp/compile/abc.so job=job-9921
[14:12:03] kv_cache_invalidate: shard=12 reason=kernel_change affected_keys=124
[14:12:05] compile_complete: job=job-9921 latency=3.2s
[14:12:06] compile_task_enqueue: model=redwood-v3 kernel=kernel_C seq=48 queue=1301
[14:12:07] compile_worker_spawn: id=43 workers=32 queue=1301
... (repeats for ~15m)```
Lina: That kv_cache_invalidate line is the smoking gun. When we flip to kernel_C we change the keying for the KV cache (different shard hash) and we end up invalidating prefixes, forcing re-encoding and new compiles.
Carol: Also saw autoscaler churn — extra nodes added because tail latency spiked, so we paid heavier CPU/GPU and warmups. End-user impact + $$$.
Maya: Bisect confirmation: reverting #2487 removes the spike. Revert candidate ready.
Lina: Proposed quick fix: restore previous scoring for seq<=64 and add a guard: if kv_evictions_last_min > 0 then prefer kernel_A. I'll open a patch to tighten the heuristic and add telemetry.
Eric: For immediate mitigation, revert looks safest. Who can push a hotfix? 
Carol: I opened revert PR #2498 which reverts commit abcdef012345. Putting it through fast-path.
build-bot: Merge check: PR #2498 (revert #2487) merged to main by Carol. Triggering CI perf/regression/small-batch canary run.
build-bot: Perf canary finished: p95=34ms (baseline ~32ms). Regression cleared ✅
Maya: Nice work. Follow-up: add a unit/regression test that simulates small-batch sequences + KV keyspace changes so autotune flips don't silently cause invalidations. Also add an alert on compile_rate spikes. Tagging @Noah @Lina to own the follow-up.
Noah: On it — will add a perf test and a canary gate so autotune changes require a perf sign-off.
Lina: I'll also add telemetry: histograms for compile_rate and kv_invalidate_rate and a heuristic safety check.
Eric: Add a note to the release blurb so on-call knows this class of failure. Might save hours next time. :+1:
Carol: Closing the immediate incident. Created follow-up ticket INF-1123 to track fixes and tests.
Maya: Thanks team. We'll reopen if anything else pops up.
